function demo(enabled: boolean) {
  // prettier-ignore
  const config = {
    enabled,
  }; // This comment describes the completed config object and should still move before the closing declaration delimiter when prettier-ignore is before the object.
  // prettier-ignore
  if (enabled) {
    runTask();
  } // This comment describes the completed conditional block and should still move before the closing block delimiter when prettier-ignore is before the block.
  // prettier-ignore
  runTask(
    config,
  ); // This comment describes the completed function call and should still move before the closing call delimiter when prettier-ignore is before the call.
}
